<includeonly>{{#invoke:Infobox|main
|kind=dmz-saga
|sep=,
|title={{#if:{{{title|}}}|{{{title}}}|{{#invoke:Labels|name}}}}
|image={{#invoke:Labels|image|{{{image|}}}}}
|caption={{{caption|}}}
|sections=Summary, General, Rewards info, Story

|Summary=Quote
|Summary_nolabel=yes
|Quote_nolabel=yes
|Quote={{#if:{{{quote|}}}|''{{{quote}}}''}}

|General_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|General}}
|Order_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Order}}
|Quests_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Quests}}
|Difficulty_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Difficulty}}
|Villains_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Villains}}

|Rewards info=Unlocks, Rewards
|Rewards info_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Rewards}}
|Rewards info_collapsible=yes
|Unlocks_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Unlocks}}
|Rewards_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Rewards}}

|Story=Previous, Next
|Story_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Story}}
|Previous_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Previous}}
|Next_label={{#invoke:Labels|get|Next}}
}}[[Category:Sagas{{#translation:}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}</noinclude>
